acquisition.method: Downloaded with curl on 2026-10-07 (UTC): one keyless HTTPS GET per case window, five seconds apart, from the Federal Reserve Board's Data Download Program direct-download address for a package of exactly the two H.15 series, built once in the Program's Build-your-package pages. No API key, cookies or FRED request were used. A reply was kept only if it was a non-empty text/csv with HTTP status 200; earlier trial and aborted requests, including two that received an empty text/html reply, were discarded, and the files kept come from one complete run.
acquisition.tool: curl 8.21.0 (Windows) libcurl/8.21.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.2 WinIDN WinLDAP
acquisition.vintage_note: No vintage was requested, and the Data Download Program offers none: its help page says data are only available as currently published and that pre-revision or real-time data are not available. These are the Board's values when retrieved, which may differ from those available on the publication date; whether any of them was revised is not known from this download.
